MinimapWidgets.Mod.Name: Minimap Widgets
MW.Common.PositionTip: Choose a position around the minimap.
MW.Common.FontSizeTip: Set the font size. Larger sizes may cause widgets to be misaligned or cut off.
MW.Common.FontStyleTip: Choose a font style for the widget.
MW.Common.ColorTip: Choose one of the main colors for the widget.
MW.Common.LetterCaseTip: Choose a letter case for the widget.
MW.Minimap.BackgroundColorTip: Choose one of the main colors for the Minimap Background.
MW.Minimap.BackgroundOpacityTip: Set opacity for the Minimap Background.
MW.Minimap.BorderColorTip: Choose one of the main colors for the Minimap Border.
MW.Minimap.BorderOpacityTip: Set opacity for the Minimap Border.
MW.Minimap.PlayerColorTip: Choose one of the main colors for the Player Icon.
MW.Minimap.PlayerOpacityTip: Set opacity for the Player Icon.
MW.Minimap.RoadsColorTip: Choose one of the main colors for the Minimap Roads.
MW.Minimap.RoadsOpacityTip: Set opacity for the Minimap Roads.
MW.Minimap.StarColorTip: Choose one of the main colors for the Wanted Stars.
MW.Minimap.GPSOpacityTip: Set opacity for the GPS Path.
MW.Minimap.ClampOpacityTip: Set opacity for all clamped markers.
MW.Minimap.ZoneSizeTip: Set font size of security area and combat state indicator.
MW.Behavior.VehicleTip: Show minimap while driving, hide while walking.
MW.Behavior.VisualsTip: Show or hide decorative elements like weapon_name and bg_dots.
MW.Behavior.CombatPulseTip: Show or hide the pulsing effect of combat state.
MW.Behavior.DrivePulseTip: Show or hide the pulsing effect of autodrive state.
MW.Behavior.ToggleMinimapKeyTip: Hotkey to show/hide minimap and wanted HUD.
MW.Markers.EnemiesTip: Show or hide enemies on the minimap.
MW.Markers.EnemiesOnlyTaggedTip: Show or hide enemies on the minimap only when they are tagged.
MW.Markers.NCPDTip: Show or hide NCPD officers and vehicles.
MW.Markers.NCPDOnlyTaggedTip: Show or hide NCPD officers and vehicles only when they are tagged.
MW.Markers.DevicesTip: Show or hide devices like cameras or turrets.
MW.Markers.VendorTip: Show or hide vendors and dropboxes.
MW.Markers.VCarTip: Show or hide the player's vehicle.
MW.Markers.TravelTip: Show or hide fast travel points and metro stations.
MW.Markers.MappinsTip: Show vanilla pins sooner and add pins for quests, gigs, and NCPD scanners.
MW.Markers.ElevationArrowTip: Show or hide vanilla elevation arrows on map pins.
MW.TextCompass.EnabledTip: Enable or disable the Text Compass Widget.
MW.CircleCompass.EnabledTip:
ON: Show Circle Compass modifications.
OFF: Hide modifications and reset to vanilla.
MW.CircleCompass.VisibleTip: Show or hide the outer compass circle.
MW.CircleCompass.NorthSizeTip:
OFF: Vanilla size indicator.
ON: Full size indicator.
MW.CircleCompass.PositionTip: Choose a position for the Circle Compass.
MW.Weather.EnabledTip: Enable or disable the Weather Widget.
MW.Coord.EnabledTip: Enable or disable the Coordinates Widget.
MW.Coord.DecimalTip: Set accuracy/decimals for the Coordinates Widget.
MW.Coord.IntervalTip: Set update interval in seconds. Lower values may affect performance.
MW.Time.EnabledTip: Enable or disable the Time Widget.
MW.Time.StoryDayTip:
ON: Appends the day counter to the clock. Requires Calendar mod.
OFF: Show normal in-game time in the selected format.
MW.Time.StoryDaySeparatorTip: Choose the separator between time and days passed.
MW.RealTime.EnabledTip: Turn the Real-Time Widget on or off. Requires RedFunctions.
MW.RealTime.TimeFormatTip: Choose how the real time is displayed.
MW.RealTime.DateFormatTip: Choose how the real date is displayed.
MW.RealTime.SeparatorTip: Choose the separator between date and time.
MW.Calendar.EnabledTip: Enable or disable the Calendar Widget.
MW.Calendar.FormatTip: Choose the format for the date display.
MW.cal.DayTip: Show the number of days passed since the selected story anchor.
MW.cal.SeparatorTip: Choose the separator between date and days passed.
MW.cal.StoryDayAnchorTip: Choose the story milestone where the day counter starts counting from.
MW.cal.StoryDaySeparatorTip: Choose the separator between time and days passed.
MW.District.EnabledTip: Enable or disable the District Widget.
MW.District.InfoTip: Select what information format to display.
MW.Gang.EnabledTip: Enable or disable the Gang Widget.
MW.Gang.InfoTip: Select how to display gangs in the area.
MW.Fixer.EnabledTip: Enable or disable the Fixer Widget.
MW.Street.EnabledTip: Enable or disable the Street Widget (Requires StreetLogger).
MW.Street.HideTip: Hides the widget when leaving the road.
MW.Street.FormatTip: Choose the format for the street display.
MW.FPS.EnabledTip: Enable or disable the FPS Widget.
MW.FPS.Color1Tip: Choose the color for the "FPS:" text.
MW.FPS.Color2Tip: Choose color for the FPS counter.
MW.Kills.EnabledTip: Enable or disable the Kills Widget.
MW.Kills.Color1Tip: Choose the color for the "KILLS:" text.
MW.Kills.Color2Tip: Choose color for the Kills counter.
MW.Money.EnabledTip: Enable or disable the Eddies Widget.
